sv.title: Styrelseavhopp ger nytt ras i utbombade bolaget
sv.summary: Styrelseledamoten Johan Eriksson avgår med omedelbar verkan från forskningsbolaget Cereno Scientifics styrelse, på egen begäran och efter stora kursförluster i bolaget. Nyheten får den redan utbombade aktien att rasa ytterligare.

en.title: Board resignation triggers new slide in the already bombed-out company
en.summary: Board member Johan Eriksson is leaving the board of research company Cereno Scientific with immediate effect, at his own request and after heavy share price losses in the company. The news is sending the already battered share down further.
